summary: A player who holds no legal Reaction is never asked to pass: after a Reaction resolves (or a pass) in any alternating reaction window (proclaim/entry, bow, move, Nikutai, attack, duel, duel-won, after-resolution, after-action-resolved, after-battle recruit, battle-action) priority goes to the other player only if they hold a legal Reaction, else the window closes through CloseReactionWindow and play continues. Generalises CloseEntryWindowIfSpent into SettleReactionWindow in Core; no client-side skip. Accepted hidden-information leak: the timing reveals that a player held nothing to react with (same as #639/#644 for Proclaim/entry). Updated ~30 existing Core test fixtures whose only expectation was a Pass offered with nothing to react with; added reaction-window-settle suite.
validation: bash tools/check.sh --skip-client passed (Core suite 2544 PASS with 0 failures incl. new reaction-window-settle 9/9 (2743 PASS lines across Core, AI, Server, Transport and Collection), content/quality/collab/hooks python suites); python -m unittest discover -s tools/content passed (150); dotnet build src/L5R.Client passed; Nightly soak --seeds 6 passed (12 matches, 61055 offered-command probes).
